description: MainActivity class for a Tic Tac Toe Android app implementing a 3x3 grid with turn-based gameplay between 'Knight' (X) and 'Queen' (O). Handles UI initialization, user interactions, game logic, win/draw detection, and game reset.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity class managing a 3x3 Tic Tac Toe game with turn logic between 'Knight' and 'Queen'.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the UI components, sets up game grid, and resets game state when activity is created.

methods.name: onCellClicked
methods.description: Handles user tap on a cell: places icon, checks for victory or draw, updates game state.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Clears game board, resets turn and game over state, and updates UI.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates status text indicating whose turn it is.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Checks for a winning line on the board; returns winner identifier or 0 if none.

methods.name: isBoardFull
methods.description: Determines if all cells are filled, indicating a draw if no winner.
